author: Max Williams
title: Victoria East faces Galena Park; Victoria west meets Houston Milby in first round softball playoffs - NewsBreak
text:
By Max Williams ,
1 days ago VICTORIA, Texas- Victoria ISD softball had a dominant district showing, with both teams finishing at the top. The Victoria West Warriors softball claimed first place with a 13-1 record, while the Victoria East Titans softball followed closely in second at 12-2.
Both teams have advanced to the postseason. Here are their first-round playoff matchups:
The Victoria East Titans softball will face the Galena Park Yellowjackets softball on April 23 at 6 p.m. The Victoria West Warriors softball will take on the Houston Milby Buffaloes softball on April 24 at 6 p.m. Both games will be held at Wharton High School , with gates opening at 5 p.m.
